name: Zeturf
verdict: ZEturf is the horse-race betting brand of FDJ United, part-owned by the French state (~20%). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Gambling sponsor. ZEturf is the horse-race betting brand of FDJ United (acquired 2023, EV 175m EUR); founder Emmanuel de Rohan Chabot sold to FDJ. The French state holds a minority stake of about 20% in FDJ United after the 2019 privatisation - a state link (>=5% along the chain) but no control and no sourced record of serious abuses by that owner, so proposed none. Licensed by the French regulator ANJ (permits N°0064-PS/PO/PH-2025-01-23-AGR-00).
